Thriller drama ‘The Season’ set for June debut on Viu

The series was produced by Hong Kong-based PCCW Media in partnership with SK Global.
Staff Reporter by Staff Reporter
May 20, 2026
in News , OTT/Video Streaming

...

tps%3A%2F%2Fwww.broadcastprome.com%2Fnews%2Fthriller-drama-the-season-set-for-june-debut-on-viu%2F
PCCW Media and SK Global have announced that their new drama series The Season will premiere on June 17, 2026, with a coordinated international rollout across multiple platforms and territories.
The six-episode series will debut on Viu across Asia, the Middle East and South Africa, while also launching on Now TV in Hong Kong. In the United States, all episodes will be released simultaneously on Hulu , with availability extending to Hulu on Disney+ for bundle subscribers.
Produced by PCCW Media in collaboration with SK Global, the studio behind projects such as Crazy Rich Asians , Thai Cave Rescue and Delhi Crime , The Season is described as a visually driven ensemble drama set within Hong Kong’s elite boating community.
The series was created by Yalun Tu , who also serves as showrunner. Marialy Rivas directs and executive produces the project.

After Imogen and her twin sister Amelia arrive, ready to pack up their mother's home, strange things begin to happen, reminding Imogen of her long held feelings of dread surrounding her hometown.
Imogen enlists the help of her first crush, next-door neighbor Rory, to uncover the truth about her mother's death and the traumatic event she experienced as a child.
